newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won closes edge higher on dlr/yen fall.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won closes edge higher on dlr/yen fall.

text.p: South Korean won closed Friday's trading higher against the U.S. dollar on the U.S. unit's drop against the Japanese yen in world markets, dealers said.
But the closing rate was far off from an intraday high as dollar demand grew late in the session on expectations of increasing importer deals early next month.
The won closed at 864.20 after opening the day at an intraday low of 864.70. It touched a high of 863.50.
"The dollar/yen's decline and expectations of growing importer deals alternated to affect trading today," said a dealer.
Dealers said traders took a low-key attitude as they were unsure about the short-term outlook.
"Traders took a break today as they wanted to wait until the direction becomes more clear," said another dealer.
Dealers saw the won's base mid-rate at 864.20 for Monday, compared with Friday's 863.90.
